card.name: Severity qualifiers before a condition
card.fires_on: Words that qualify a condition or status, such as clinically, objective, chronic, physical and maternally, right before a severity or grade term. They often appear in lists of severity grades, kidney disease stages and toxic-dose statements.

modes.label: Qualifier before patients or loss
modes.description: An adverb or adjective such as clinically, objective or chronic that sits before a condition or patient group.
modes.example: serious infections were limited to<< clinically>> complex patients.

modes.label: Partway through qualifier words
modes.description: The middle of a longer word such as maternally or cutaneous, ahead of toxic or a disease term.

card.writes: Weakly promotes odd word endings and some Chinese words while suppressing 'level' words, so it gives no clear help in English.
card.plain: It lights up on small qualifying words that come just before a severity or condition term.
